limitations: This reviewer accidentally saw later labels in raw labeledAtOpen while checking provenance; exact exposure is preserved separately. Historical semantic review cannot be called blind to later maintainer behavior. The author independently fixed expectations without that exposure.
No candidate policy, protocol, harness, proposals, or coordinator decision results had been opened at seal. Later score recomputation must remain separate from this annotation review.
Only 12 historical inputs; all expect some component action, so fresh natural historical no-action behavior is not represented. A constructed maintainer skip covers one no-action rule.
The constructed references and gist links are offline fixtures; no claim of real Electron bugs, link reachability or executable hosted reproductions.
Manual earlier-corpus search cannot prove no distant historical semantic match exists.
Three ambiguous reproduction cases allow label and comment independently, as the unchanged scorer schema permits. A clean pass is not evidence of perfect reproduction judgment on those cases.

Frozen score_run only requires at least one refs_any match and does not penalize extra unsupported refs when a correct ref is also supplied. The experiment protocol must separately audit every emitted reference and per-case regression.
A single paired sample can assess tested cases only; it cannot establish universal non-regression, hosted model performance, threat detection, repository permissions, or publication behavior.
followup_checks_required: Prepared runtime inputs must remove case set/source/annotation/focus metadata and neutralize identifiers consistently; only input plus cutoff corpus and same baseline runtime may vary by policy.
Protocol must measure full frozen correctness, every unsupported ref, missing supported links, component errors, reproduction errors, safety and per-pair regressions before an adoption decision.
Known previously failed cases must remain a separate result from fresh cases.
